score: Geometric mean across launch blocks and common inputs of per-input three-call median client elapsed time to binary PNG consumption.
interval: 10000 paired launch-block bootstrap samples, seed20261029; fixed cases. Pairwise unadjusted95% intervals, observed ranking.
repeatability: Odd/even block split is a diagnostic warning; no all-participant ratio suppression.
failures: No outlier trimming. Errors/unsupported/contract failures retained. A correctness/stability failure excludes that input for all participants; any measured timeout changes history and makes the campaign incomplete rather than silently replacing a block.
timingScope: Warm repeated export. No cold-start, widget frame, source-update or DOM presentation claim. Driver IPC and binary delivery included, file and SVG witness capture after clock.
